garbage_note: four 'supported' Arctic sites were one vessel logging a constant 0.7 m over 100 m water
bc_note: the one remaining supported site (48.969N 123.070W) is 530 m from shore in 60-110 m water with small-boat pings of 5-8 m: coastal shallows, not an offshore shoal
caveat: ships choose safe water, so pings within 300 m can miss a pinnacle narrower than 100 m; refutation is strong for broad shoals, weaker for pinnacles
